description: Tasks for StreamShield Azure Phase 1, with Fabric and Power BI deferred.

tasks.description: Capture current behavior of the in-scope Python backend before Azure migration.
tasks.requirements: Create a frozen behavior specification and mock/real decision table for external dependencies used by migration verification. Operate on a snapshot of backend/ only. Do not modify application code.

tasks.description: Prepare and validate the Azure infrastructure design without provisioning.
tasks.requirements: Prepare a deployable Bicep design for the Azure Container Apps API and worker, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Managed Redis, private networking, monitoring, and application configuration. Keep provisioning disabled. Target the enabled Azure for Students subscription in East US 2, confirmed by the user; the subscription currently has no resource groups. Quota and full cost remain unverified. The total Azure consumption must remain within US$50/month including credits. Do not include identifiers, connection strings, or secrets. Fabric and Power BI integration are deferred.

tasks.description: Move the operational and dimensional PostgreSQL database to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the in-scope Python backend's PostgreSQL connection and data from its current host to Azure Database for PostgreSQL while preserving schema, application behavior, and the dimensional analytics warehouse. Use managed identity where supported and document backup, parity, cutover, and rollback. Ensure API analytics continues to use PostgreSQL. Do not migrate or enable BigQuery, Fabric, or Power BI embedding in this phase. Do not provision resources or include credentials or resource IDs.

tasks.description: Move the StreamShield API and worker Redis connectivity to Azure Managed Redis.
tasks.requirements: Migrate Redis connectivity while preserving queue, cache, worker, and required TCP behavior. Use managed identity and TLS where supported; document private network access and failover. Do not provision Azure resources or include secrets or resource IDs.

tasks.description: Build integration tests for the migrated Azure services and verify application behavior.
tasks.requirements: Use mock mode while no Azure environment is available. Verify API/worker service boundaries, PostgreSQL and Redis behavior, health/readiness, and analytics queries against the PostgreSQL dimensional warehouse. Reuse the frozen behavior specification and external-dependency decision table from setupBaseline. Do not provision resources or store identifiers, connection strings, or secrets. Do not claim a live Azure verification.

tasks.description: Scan and remediate dependency vulnerabilities in the in-scope backend migration.
tasks.requirements: Scan dependencies for the Python backend and remediate applicable vulnerabilities with patched versions. Verify relevant builds and tests. Exclude backend-spring and unrelated security scope.

tasks.description: Deploy the Python API and worker to Azure Container Apps after the cost and resource gates are satisfied.
tasks.requirements: Prepare an isolated Azure test for 25 November 2026 18:00 through 26 November 2026 18:00 UTC-05:00; keep existing Vercel/Render production traffic unchanged and delete all Azure resources created for the test at the end. Do not provision until a current itemized estimate confirms all Azure consumption remains within US$50/month, credit application/overage and quota are verified, and the user explicitly approves the exact resource creation. The user-provided screenshot shows US$100 Azure for Students credit available until 2027-11-24 and US$0 November cost; do not treat this as approval to exceed the US$50/month consumption cap. Use the user-confirmed East US 2 region. Confirm resource group, SKUs, images, identities, private network, secrets, test data strategy, health checks, and reliable cleanup before creating resources. Fabric/Power BI remain deferred.
